scope: Bounded circulating-factor/immune primary FSGS and separate APOL1-associated kidney injury branch; excludes other genetic, adaptive, viral and drug-associated FSGS. APOL1-associated disease is not classified as idiopathic primary FSGS.

paragraphs.text: IFNγ-induced APOL1 G1 in transgenic mouse podocytes produced ion-flux and injury phenotypes reversible by VX-147. Inaxaplin inhibited APOL1 channel function in preclinical cell assays. Induced G1 expression produced sodium import and potassium efflux in HEK293 experiments.

These selected findings describe a bounded candidate, whose overall explanation has not been independently checked against current literature. Abstract-level inspection; no independent domain review or complete methods appraisal. Overexpression system; G1 result does not by itself establish identical G2 effects or penetrance in humans. Treatment efficacy has not been synthesized in this summary.
